cover_headline: Canada’s Immigration Backlog Falls to 1.51 Million as IRCC Finalizes 3 Million Files
facts: IRCC finalized 3,001,860 applications in the first nine months of 2026 and cut its total inventory to 1,508,675 by September 30
The permanent residence backlog fell to 707,405, but family-class files rose by 1,685 to 168,855, the only major stream that grew
Work permit and study permit queues are down to 24,970 and 24,910 files, while visitor visas account for 298,060 files

end.headline: Canada’s Immigration Backlog Falls to 1.51 Million as IRCC Finalizes 3 Million Files
end.line: IRCC cut its inventory by 35,180 applications in September, but family sponsorships grew, and 22% of economic files are waiting for levels-plan space rather than a decision.
